# franchisetech

> Cloud POS and business operations software for small food businesses in Romania: cafés, restaurants, takeaway, patisseries and bakeries.

franchisetech is a browser-based workspace: POS register, products and stock, purchases, recipe costing, till close (Z-report) and owner reports. It is operations-first, not a payment-terminal vendor. Operated by SALUT TECH SRL.

**Full AI index:** https://franchisetech.ro/llms-full.txt

## Market

- Romania only. Currency: lei (RON). Romanian TVA rates: 21%, 11%, 0%.
- Fiscal receipts go through the FiscalNet fiscal driver (driverfiscal.ro, a third-party program with its own licence, bought separately) and a compatible fiscal cash register or fiscal printer, when enabled and configured on the till PC.
- Overview for Romania: https://franchisetech.ro/industries/romania

## Pricing and trial

- Pricing: https://franchisetech.ro/pricing (prices exclude VAT)
- Pro: €49/month for one location (€39/month billed annually).
- Multi: €79/month for the first location (€63/month billed annually), plus €29/month for each extra location; extra locations are added on request.
- 15-day trial with all Pro features, no card required. After the trial you can keep selling and issuing fiscal receipts; stock, recipes and accountant exports need a Pro or Multi subscription.
- Guided setup is free. Unlimited staff on paid plans. No long-term contract.
- Signup: https://franchisetech.ro/signup
